privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC

Effective Date: October 27, 2026

## Introduction

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC ("Company," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you provide when visiting our website, purchasing downloadable fitness training applications, or using our digital fitness products and services.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information.

## Information We Collect

When you visit our website or purchase our downloadable fitness applications, we may collect the following information:

• Full name
• Email address
• Billing information
• Purchase and transaction history
• Account information, if applicable
• Device information and website usage data
• Fitness goals or other information voluntarily provided

Payment information may be processed through secure third-party payment processors. We do not intentionally store complete credit card numbers on our website.

## How We Use Your Information

Information collected may be used to:

• Process purchases and payments.
• Provide access to purchased fitness applications.
• Deliver downloadable digital products.
• Provide customer support.
• Send purchase confirmations and important account notifications.
• Improve our website, applications, and services.
• Prevent fraudulent transactions and unauthorized access.
• Comply with applicable legal obligations.

We do not sell your personal information for money.

## Third-Party Services

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC may use third-party providers for payment processing, website hosting, analytics, and digital product delivery.

These providers may process information necessary to perform their services.

## Data Security

We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to help protect personal information against unauthorized access, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.

However, no internet-based system or electronic transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

## Cookies and Website Tracking

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to improve website functionality, understand visitor activity, and enhance the customer experience.

Where required by law, visitors will be provided with applicable cookie notices and choices.

## Customer Privacy Rights

Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have rights to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, as well as other privacy choices.

We will respond to verified privacy requests as required by applicable law.

## Children's Privacy

Our website and digital fitness applications are intended for adults aged 18 and older.

We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children under 13.

## Changes to This Privacy Policy

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC reserves the right to modify this Privacy Policy as necessary to reflect changes in business practices, technology, or legal requirements.

Updates will be posted on our website with a revised effective date.

## Contact Information

For privacy-related questions, please contact:

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC
Website: www.elitebodyfitnesspros.com
Email: art@elitebodyfitnesspros.com

© 2026 Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC. All Rights Reserved.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.body:
Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC

Effective Date: October 27, 2026

## Acceptance of Terms

By accessing our website, purchasing, downloading, or using any fitness training application offered by Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.

Please read these terms carefully before making a purchase.

## Digital Fitness Products

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC offers downloadable personal training and fitness applications designed to provide exercise guidance, workout programs, fitness education, and related training resources.

All digital products are intended for personal fitness and educational purposes.

## One-Time Purchase Agreement

All downloadable fitness applications are sold through a one-time purchase payment unless otherwise clearly stated at checkout.

Your purchase includes:

• Access to the specific fitness application purchased.
• Features and training content included in that application at the time of purchase.
• Access according to the product description and any disclosed technical or access limitations.
• No recurring monthly or annual subscription charges for the purchased application.

IMPORTANT: A one-time purchase applies only to the specific fitness application purchased. It does not automatically include future applications, newly released programs, upgraded versions, or additional digital fitness products.

## New Applications and Future Releases

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC may develop, introduce, or release additional fitness applications, training programs, digital products, and upgraded applications.

Customers acknowledge and agree that:

• Newly released applications are not included with previous purchases.
• Future fitness applications must be purchased separately.
• New training programs or premium digital products may require an additional one-time payment.
• Purchasing an existing application does not entitle customers to complimentary access to future applications.
• Product upgrades, additional features, or expanded training content may be sold separately.

Any complimentary updates or additional features will be provided solely at the Company's discretion unless otherwise expressly included in the original purchase agreement.

## Application Access and Availability

Customers receive access to the purchased digital fitness application according to the terms stated in the product description at the time of purchase.

Access may depend on compatible devices, operating systems, internet connectivity, third-party platforms, and continued technical availability.

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC may perform maintenance, address security concerns, and make reasonable technical changes to its applications.

Any specific access duration or lifetime-access commitment must be expressly stated in the applicable product description.

## Personal Use License

Purchasing a fitness application grants the customer a limited, nonexclusive, nontransferable license to use the purchased product for personal, noncommercial purposes.

Customers may not:

• Resell or redistribute applications.
• Share purchased applications with unauthorized users.
• Reproduce or distribute copyrighted training materials without permission.
• Modify, reverse engineer, or commercially exploit application software except as permitted by applicable law.
• Claim ownership of Company intellectual property.

All application content, branding, training materials, graphics, and associated intellectual property remain the property of Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC or its licensors.

## Health and Fitness Disclaimer

All fitness applications, workout programs, exercise demonstrations, and educational materials provided by Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC are intended for general informational and educational purposes.

Our digital products do not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

Customers should consult a qualified healthcare professional before beginning a new exercise program, particularly if they have existing medical conditions, injuries, or other health concerns.

Physical exercise involves inherent risks, including muscle soreness, strains, falls, and other injuries.

Customers are responsible for exercising within their abilities, using proper techniques, and discontinuing activities that cause pain, dizziness, or unusual discomfort.

## Results Disclaimer

Individual fitness results vary based on numerous factors, including consistency, exercise technique, nutrition, health status, and personal circumstances.

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC does not guarantee specific results, including:

• Weight loss
• Muscle growth
• Strength improvements
• Body fat reduction
• Physical transformation within a specific timeframe

Testimonials and examples of results are not guarantees of individual outcomes.

## Payment Authorization

By completing a purchase, customers authorize the applicable one-time charge displayed during checkout.

Customers are responsible for reviewing the product description, compatibility requirements, price, and purchase conditions before completing their transaction.

## Refund Agreement

All digital application purchases are subject to the Company's Refund Policy.

ALL SALES ARE FINAL. NO REFUNDS, RETURNS, OR EXCHANGES WILL BE PROVIDED EXCEPT WHERE REQUIRED BY APPLICABLE LAW.

Customers acknowledge this policy before completing a purchase.

## Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from the use of its website or digital products.

Nothing in these Terms and Conditions excludes or limits liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited.

## Changes to Terms and Conditions

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC reserves the right to update these Terms and Conditions.

Revised terms will be posted on the Company's website.

Changes will not retroactively alter completed purchase agreements where prohibited by law.

## Contact Information

For questions regarding these Terms and Conditions, please contact:

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC
Website: www.elitebodyfitnesspros.com
Email: art@elitebodyfitnesspros.com

© 2026 Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC. All Rights Reserved.

refund.title: Refund Policy — All Sales Final
refund.body:
Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC

Effective Date: October 27, 2026

## No Refund Policy

Thank you for choosing Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC.

We offer downloadable personal training and fitness applications through our website.

Due to the digital nature of our products, ALL SALES ARE FINAL.

Once a purchase is completed, refunds, returns, cancellations for reimbursement, or exchanges will not be provided, except where required by applicable law.

## One-Time Purchase

All downloadable fitness applications are offered through a one-time purchase payment unless otherwise specified.

Customers are charged the full purchase price displayed at checkout.

There are no recurring subscription fees associated with a product advertised as a one-time purchase.

The one-time purchase grants access only to the specific application purchased, subject to the terms and access conditions disclosed at checkout.

## No Refunds on Digital Applications

Because our fitness applications are digital products that may be downloaded or accessed electronically, purchases are considered final.

Refunds will not ordinarily be issued for:

• Changes of mind after purchasing.
• Failure to use the purchased application.
• Dissatisfaction with workout programs or training content.
• Failure to achieve desired fitness results.
• Purchasing an application without reviewing its description.
• Purchasing an application that does not meet the customer's personal preferences.
• Requests to exchange an existing application for another product.

This policy does not limit any refund, cancellation, or other remedy required by applicable consumer protection laws.

## New Applications Are Not Included

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING FUTURE APPLICATIONS

Purchasing a downloadable fitness application from Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC does not include automatic access to newly released applications or future digital products.

Customers understand and agree that:

• Each application is sold as a separate digital product unless expressly advertised otherwise.
• Newly released applications are not included with previous purchases.
• Future application releases may require an additional one-time purchase.
• Updated or upgraded applications may be sold separately.
• Customers are not entitled to complimentary access to future applications solely because they purchased an earlier product.

Purchasing one fitness application does not provide unlimited access to all current or future applications offered by Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC.

## Download and Access Responsibility

Customers are responsible for reviewing application descriptions, device compatibility, and access requirements before purchasing.

If a customer experiences difficulty downloading or accessing a purchased application, they should contact Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC for assistance.

We will make reasonable efforts to address verified delivery or technical access issues.

If a purchased digital product cannot be delivered or accessed as promised, any remedies required by applicable law will remain available.

## Payment Disputes

Customers are encouraged to contact Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC regarding billing errors, duplicate charges, unauthorized transactions, or product delivery problems.

Nothing in this policy restricts a customer's lawful right to dispute a charge with their payment provider.

## Customer Acknowledgment

By completing a purchase through the Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC website, customers acknowledge that they have reviewed and accepted the following conditions:

1. ALL SALES ARE FINAL.
2. NO REFUNDS OR EXCHANGES ARE PROVIDED, EXCEPT WHERE REQUIRED BY LAW.
3. ALL APPLICATIONS ARE PURCHASED THROUGH A ONE-TIME PAYMENT UNLESS OTHERWISE SPECIFIED.
4. PURCHASES INCLUDE ONLY THE SPECIFIC APPLICATION PURCHASED.
5. NEWLY RELEASED APPLICATIONS, FUTURE PRODUCTS, AND SEPARATELY SOLD UPGRADES ARE NOT INCLUDED IN THE ORIGINAL PURCHASE PRICE.

## Changes to Refund Policy

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC reserves the right to update this Refund Policy as necessary.

Any changes will be published on our website and will apply prospectively, subject to applicable law and existing purchase agreements.

## Contact Information

For questions regarding purchases, application access, or this Refund Policy, please contact:

Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC
Website: www.elitebodyfitnesspros.com
Email: art@elitebodyfitnesspros.com

© 2026 Elite Body Fitness Pros LLC. All Rights Reserved.
